Move in Date - 12.12.16

**

Thank you for your interest in this rental.

Please Click Here To Schedule A Showing:

http
www.schedulearentalshowing.com/

Once you complete the on-line process we will confirm your showing as soon as possible. Please be ready to view and apply.  Bring a copy of your recent credit report, landlord references, Offer Letters or last two pay statements to the showing and a check book to place a holding deposit if you like the rental. 

Our rentals go fast so be prepared!

If you have a roommate or roommates sharing the rental with you it is best to have all roommates at the showing or prepare a Face-Time call or do a video because we do not go back and forth on the showings.

**

Calling All Renters, Relocation Renters Moving to San Francisco and Renters Currently Staying in Corporate Housing and Need A Great Rental!

**

New home in Pacific Heights Furnished or Unfurnished for $11,950.00 per month same price Ready Now.

**

- The beautiful light filled home is located on the top of a hill at the corner of Green St and Scott St. The home boasts an enchanted front garden entrance and rear patio with a backyard perfect for weekend barbecues and enjoying the warm Pacific Heights weather.

- Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, formal living room, formal dining room with nook, fully equipped kitchen, laundry room, two patios, hardwood floors, front yard and backyard. 

- Living room is complete with a Sofa-bed, love seats, fireplace and HD Television. First floor bedroom is complete with a full bathroom. Second floor has 3 bedrooms and a full bath. Two bedrooms enjoy the front garden views. Spacious rear master bedroom opens to private deck with views of the city.	

- Conveniently located one block from Union St and walking distance from grocery stores, cafes, restaurants, night clubs and shopping. This home scored a 93% - A Walker's Paradise on Walkscore!

**

Move In Cost:

First Month's Rent
One month Security Deposit
Broker Fee equal to 50% of the first month's rent
Total move in cost: $29,875.00

**

Thank you and Welcome to San Francisco!

**
